decision.reason: [ev-a89ac42d3167] only says that OperatorHub packages are no longer published and that v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub. It does not say that an upgrade or install fails, and it does not say what happens to existing OperatorHub/OLM installations, which may simply stay on v1.16.5 and keep working. It also does not name a migration step, so the proposed upgrade-blocked kind (mandatory work) and its 'move off OperatorHub' remediation go beyond the text. To decide, we need evidence on what happens to existing OperatorHub-installed cert-manager when nothing is done (for example, whether the subscription breaks or a move to another install method is required).
